title: What recruiters want to see FIRST on your resume ✍️
description:
If you could brag about ONE thing you did at your last job... what would you say? Thinking about two great achievements is the perfect way to get started on your professional summary and having that at the top of your resume will keep a recruiter reading leading to more interviews. #resumetips #resume #resumeadvice #jobinterview #jobinterviewtips #jobsearchtips #professionaldevelopment
